text: The City Clerk's Office has received notice that Kiarash Kiai has resigned from the Property Standards Committee effective April 18, 2023. Staff from the Public Appointments Secretariat in the City Clerk's Office are planning to lead a recruitment and selection process for this committee in the coming months and this vacant position will be considered as part of that process.
The Property Standards Committee, Scarborough Panel: 1. Received the letter (May 4, 2023) from the Acting Manager, Public Appointments Secretariat on behalf of the City Clerk for information.
